_comment: How a machine in an untrusted zone is known: the key of the label and
taint it carries, whose value is its zone, and the key of the taint it
joins with and keeps until its clean snapshot is taken.
The one place these are written. OpenTofu reads this file, Go is
generated from it (scripts/details/facts) and the alerts are handed it
by Flux, so the machine, the program that lifts the taint and the
query that finds the machine cannot name different keys.
Where work is sent the key is written out: a pod's selector and
toleration are read before Flux substitutes anything - by the engineer's
trial of a change against the site's own nodes - so a variable there
